boxes.text: Read [justine.lol/matmul](https://justine.lol/matmul/) end-to-end. Extract the exact Zen 4 ukernel pattern for Q8_0. ✅ 2026-07-29 — the transferable pattern is **output-tile outer-product scheduling**, not inner-K unrolling: use a 3×4 primary tile (12 independent accumulators), load each activation vector once for its four output columns and each weight vector once for its three activation rows, then partition flattened tiles deterministically across the existing `(ith, nth)` workers (no nested BLAS/OpenMP). Cover remainders with 4×1, 1×4, then 1×1 tiles. The article's concrete code is FP32 SGEMM; it does **not** specify a drop-in Zen-4 Q8_0 dot primitive. Any Q8_0 experiment must retain the existing block-scale/dequantization and signed-dot correctness path, applying only this tile/worker structure before a separately approved build-and-measure gate. Source: [Tunney, "LLaMA Now Goes Faster on CPUs"](https://justine.lol/matmul/) (read 2026-07-29; direct TLS certificate was expired, so content was corroborated through the search cache and inspected read-only with certificate verification explicitly bypassed).

Read [Gope et al., arXiv:2501.00032](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.00032). Extract the GEMV register-blocking and codebook-resident technique. ✅ 2026-07-29 — portable **GEMV** idea: process several consecutive output channels together and permanently interleave their quantized groups in the exact SIMD consumption order, so activation values/scales are reused, vector lanes accumulate distinct output channels (rather than pseudo-scalar partials), scale conversion is vectorized, and no per-inference permutation is needed. The Arm-specific signed-nibble optimization and MMLA choices do not transfer as-is to Zen 4; preserve ggml's quant-format semantics and assess only format-compatible channel packing under a separately approved build/measure gate. The **codebook** idea is also format-dependent: cluster normalized group distributions into a small fixed set of codebooks so their small centroid tables can live in registers; it is a new quantization format/quality-contract proposal, not a kernel-only optimization. Source: [Gope et al., arXiv:2501.00032](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.00032), §§4.1–4.1.2 and §5 (read 2026-07-29).

Profile a baseline Qwen3.6-27B Q8_0 decode. ✅ 2026-07-14 (audit: Session 15 part 4 perf profile — 72% vec_dot, 22% barrier, 0.17 IPC) **Note (2026-04-23 audit): `perf` is NOT installed on the host** (`which perf` empty; `linux-tools-$(uname -r)` absent).
